functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'role') = 'admin',
    false
  );
$function$

Public can read published blog posts
Anyone can send a contact message

Anyone can submit a corporate quote

policies.qual:
(is_active AND ((agency_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM agencies a
  WHERE ((a.id = messagerie_agencies.agency_id) AND a.is_active)))))

policies.policyname: Admins can read all parcel rates

policies.qual:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM site_pages p
  WHERE ((p.id = site_page_media.page_id) AND p.is_active AND p.is_published))) AND ((asset_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM site_media_assets a
  WHERE ((a.id = site_page_media.asset_id) AND a.is_active AND a.is_published)))))

(is_active AND is_published AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM site_pages p
  WHERE ((p.id = site_sections.page_id) AND p.is_active AND p.is_published))))

((bucket_id = 'site-media'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM site_media_assets a
  WHERE ((a.storage_path = objects.name) AND a.is_active AND a.is_published))))
